title: Transition from the First Field State
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Booleans, let $y$ be a Boolean input word, and let $p$ be a natural number with $1\le p\le |y|$. Suppose the symbol of $y$ at zero-based position $p-1$ is $b$. For any flag $f$, bit vector, and three Boolean words $w_X,w_C,w_O$, one step of the constructed machine from the configuration in state $fA$ with input head at position $p$ and those words on its auxiliary tapes yields the configuration in state $fB$ with flag $f$, bit $b$, and the same bit vector, words, and output; the input head advances to position $p+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
A bit vector of the prescribed length is given
